overview: The Siren Dominion is the political and magical heart of the Siren Courts. It is a place of beauty, danger, and ritual power.
history: The Dominion formed after the collapse of the Combine Empire, when sirens seized abandoned arcane sites.
Coral palaces were grown using resonance magic harvested from Combine ruins.
The Courts established tidal arenas for ritual combat and political displays.
Siren matriarchs began harvesting arcane resonance from the Twilight Reef and Deepwater Trench.
Mariner clans were forced to negotiate trade routes through siren-controlled waters.
hooks: A siren matriarch demands tribute from mariner clans.
A resonance sanctum destabilizes, threatening the coral palace.
Siren hunters pursue a powerful aberration into the Dominion.
A Combine relic is discovered beneath the palace foundations.
